title: Loan Approval Rates and Risk Categorization
realWorldScenario: Risk managers at ApexFin NBFC need a summary of loan application statuses grouped by purpose.
questionStatement: Write a query on `loan_applications` grouping by `purpose`, returning the `purpose`, `total_applications` (count of rows), and `total_amount_requested` (sum of requested_amount), ordered by `total_amount_requested` descending.
starterCode:
-- Group loan applications by purpose
SELECT
  purpose,
  COUNT(*) AS total_applications,
  SUM(requested_amount) AS total_amount_requested
FROM loan_applications
GROUP BY purpose
ORDER BY total_amount_requested DESC;
hints: Group by purpose and sum the requested_amount column.

testCases.description: Verify loan applications aggregated by purpose
